module.purpose: Defines the shared provider tree for the application-directory web app, configuring theme, feature flags, organization branding, event collection, tooltips, and conditional analytics/support integrations.
module.summary: This module composes React context providers used around application pages. It derives embed and pathname state for theme configuration, obtains feature flags and organization branding from hooks, and conditionally includes support and analytics providers only outside booking pages to reduce public booking-page overhead.
module.businessContext: Supports Cal.com scheduling pages and embedded booking experiences with consistent theming, branding, flags, analytics, and support integrations. Failure can disrupt page rendering, embed appearance, organization customization, or telemetry.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the page is a booking page, the provider tree excludes Helpscout and PostHog providers.
moduleContractTests.then: DynamicHelpscoutProvider and DynamicPostHogProvider are not rendered
moduleContractTests.rationale: Booking pages intentionally avoid optional tracking and support providers for performance.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the page is not a booking page, the provider tree includes Helpscout and PostHog providers.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Non-booking pages require the optional support and analytics integrations.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When running without a browser window, the embed namespace is read from the embed search parameter.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Server rendering must derive embed identity from URL parameters.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When neither a client embed namespace nor an embed query parameter exists, no embed namespace is returned.
moduleContractTests.rationale: The absence of embed configuration must remain distinguishable from a configured namespace.
